description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing organization role permissions, including adding, listing, setting, and removing permissions, with route guards and decorators for authorization.

classes.name: OrganizationsRolesPermissionsController
classes.description: Controller for managing organization role permissions, including CRUD operations with authorization guards.

methods.name: addPermissions
methods.description: Adds permissions to an organization role, supporting batch addition.

methods.name: listPermissions
methods.description: Lists permissions for a specific organization role.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Replaces all permissions for a specific organization role.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a single permission from an organization role.

methods.name: removePermissions
methods.description: Removes multiple permissions from an organization role.
